items.title: A functor admitting a representable morphism to an algebraic space is an algebraic space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an algebraic space F over S and a representable transformation G -> F of functors, the functor G is an algebraic space (source lines 1926-1936). The proof first obtains that G is a sheaf, then computes the diagonal of G through the cartesian square relating G x_F G to F x F, uses representability of the diagonal of a representable transformation and stability under composition to make Delta_G representable, and finally transports a surjective etale chart U -> F to the chart U' = U x_F G -> G.
